name: Lomita City Council
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, October 02, 2018 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation – Council Member Waronek
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
6.
CITY MANAGER’S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-f, be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading of resolutions and ordinances
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Regular meeting held on September 18, 2018
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Approve the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That the demands and payroll be received and filed.
Item #7c
d.
Consideration of adoption of a Heat Illness Prevention Plan and a revised Automated External Defibrillator Program
ACTION: That the City Council approve the Heat Illness Prevention Plan and revised Automated External Defibrillator Program.
Item #7d
e.
Receive and File the Notice of Intention to amend the City of Lomita’s Conflict of Interest Code
ACTION: That the City Council receive and file the Notice of Intention to amend the City of Lomita’s Conflict of Interest Code.
Item #7e
f.
Contract Amendment with Interwest Consulting Group to extend the term of the contract
ACTION: That the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute the amendment to the contract to extend the term to June 30, 2019.
Item#7f
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
8.
APPROVE DISSOLUTION OF RAILROAD MUSEUM BOARD
Presented by Parks & Recreation Director Harding
ORD NO. 799 – AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, REPEALING CHAPTER 13 (RAILROAD MUSEUM BOARD) OF TITLE II OF THE LOMITA MUNICIPAL CODE, AMENDING CHAPTER 10 OF TITLE II (PARKS & RECREATION COMMISSION) TO INCLUDE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES PREVIOUSLY ASSIGNED TO THE RAILROAD MUSEUM BOARD, REMOVING RAILROAD MUSEUM BOARD MEMBERS FROM THE DEFINITION OF CITY OFFICIAL IN CHAPTER 5 OF TITLE II (REVOLVING DOOR ORDINANCE) AND FINDING THE SAME CATEGORICALLY EXEMPT FROM THE CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT. (FIRST READING)
Item #8
9.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council adjourn in memory of Keene Wilson, former City Manager, to the next regular meeting to be held on Tuesday, October 16, 2018, at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, located at 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in the City Hall lobby and bulletin board, and posted on the City’s website not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. A copy of said Agenda is on file in the Office of the City Clerk.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
